queriesList.name: Active Pipelines

options.description: Pipelines currently mapped to at least one dataflow. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Pipelines

queriesList.query: count(group by (pipelineName)(apica_ingest_pipeline_status{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Active Rules

options.description: Rules attached to pipelines that run on at least one dataflow. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Rules

queriesList.query: count(group by (pipelineName, ruleName)(apica_pipeline_rules_namespace_app_mapping{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Active Data Flows

options.description: Namespace/app dataflows with at least one pipeline mapped. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Data Flows

queriesList.query: count(group by (exported_namespace, app)(apica_ingest_pipeline_status{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Active Forwarders

options.description: Forward targets mapped to at least one dataflow. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Forwarders

queriesList.query: count(group by (target)(flow_forwarder_mapping{exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

options.description: Bytes removed by pipeline rules (dropped events, removed or masked fields, shortened messages) in the selected time range.
options.label: Bytes Filtered

queriesList.name: Bytes Difference (Saved) %

options.description: Bytes removed by pipeline rules as a share of bytes in, over the selected time range.

queriesList.query: round(clamp_max(sum(increase(apica_pipeline_savings_bytes{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) / (sum(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) > 0) * 100, 100), 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Events Difference (Saved)

options.description: Events in minus events out across the selected pipelines, in the selected time range.
options.label: Events Saved

queriesList.query: round(sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) - sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])), 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Events Filtered In vs Out %

options.description: Share of events that pipelines did not pass on: 1 - events out / events in, over the selected time range.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) / (sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Bytes Saved per Pipeline %

queriesList.query: round(clamp_max(sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_pipeline_savings_bytes{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) / (sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) > 0) * 100, 100), 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Events Saved per Pipeline %
